selection: minimum mean parent-validation NLL, no final test data generated or evaluated in this mechanism pilot
evaluation: uniform fixed coordinates in complete true genealogies with census nodes and truth annotations removed
interpretation: Independent larger-query exploratory cohort. 64 query haplotypes and 24 references. No final test generation, performance or novelty claim. Tests whether cross-query memory has measurable benefit in a larger panel.
comparison_note: Independent simulation seeds relative to all earlier datasets. The same fixed observed-reference adapter is prepared. Boundary studies will reuse these parents only through a separately hash-bound frozen preparation.
